module pulse_detect(    
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

reg [1:0] state; // 0: idle, 1: rising detected, 2: falling detected, 3: pulse output

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        state <= 2'b00;
        data_out <= 0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin
                data_out <= 0; // ensure output is low in idle
                if (data_in == 1'b1)
                    state <= 2'b01; // detect rising edge
                else
                    state <= 2'b00; // stay in idle
            end
            2'b01: begin
                if (data_in == 1'b0)
                    state <= 2'b10; // detect falling edge after rising
                else
                    state <= 2'b01; // stay in rising state if still high
                data_out <= 0;
            end
            2'b10: begin
                if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= 2'b11; // pulse detected, set output
                    data_out <= 1;
                end else
                    state <= 2'b10; // stay in falling state if still high
            end
            2'b11: begin
                // After setting output high for one cycle, reset to idle
                state <= 2'b00;
                data_out <= 0;
            end
            default: begin
                state <= 2'b00;
                data_out <= 0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

module RAM (
	input clk,
	input rst_n,
	
	input write_en,
	input [7:0] write_addr,
	input [5:0] write_data,
	
	input read_en,
	input [7:0] read_addr,
	output reg [5:0] read_data
);

reg [5:0] mem [0:7]; // 8 locations, 6-bit each

integer i;

// Synchronous reset and memory initialization
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (!rst_n) begin
		for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
			mem[i] <= 6'b000000;
		end
	end else begin
		if (write_en) begin
			if (write_addr[2:0] < 8) begin
				mem[write_addr[2:0]] <= write_data;
			end
		end
	end
end

// Synchronous read operation
always @(posedge clk) begin
	if (read_en) begin
		if (read_addr[2:0] < 8) begin
			read_data <= mem[read_addr[2:0]];
		end else begin
			read_data <= 6'b000000;
		end
	end else begin
		read_data <= 6'b000000;
	end
end

endmodule
